叶寒冷眼望向戴沐白，语气中充满了威严和冷漠。

似乎只要戴沐白敢拒绝，他就会毫不犹豫地直接动手。

朱竹清见叶寒要替她做主，帮她解除婚约，深受感动。

身为星罗帝国朱家之女，要想摆脱命运，最主要的方法就是不断提升实力，成为家族继承人，或者是成为封号斗罗彻底摆脱帝国和家族的约束，获得自由之身。

除了这种方法外，还有一个要求十分苛刻的方法，那就是解除婚约。

但不是所有人都能解除婚约，需要满足一些十分严格的条件，还必须由戴家皇子主动提出，经过帝国同意才行。

而提出解除婚约的皇子必须具备没有生育能力，或者得了大病，受了重伤等情况。

只要皇子身体健康，就必须遵循家族规矩，竞争上位。

否则，提出解除婚约的皇子，要遭受帝国严格惩罚。

如今，叶寒为了帮她摆脱家族的竞争规则，竟然让戴沐白主动提出解除婚约，让他一人承担责任，把她的风险降到最低，如何让她不感动。

【叮！朱竹清忠诚度40%，奖励5000兑换值。】

叶寒收到了系统的提示声，知道解除婚约的做法奏效了。

无论如何，他今天必须帮朱竹清把婚约取消。

“婚约？”

“弗院长，他们该不会是星罗戴家和朱家的人吧。”

“难怪我看他们的武魂这么眼熟。”

宁风致听到婚约两字，瞬间猜到了戴沐白和朱竹清的身份，向弗兰德寻求答案。

“是的。”

弗兰德点了点头，脸上满是无奈。

斗罗大陆几乎所有魂师都知道星罗皇室的规则。

想要解除婚约，实在太难了。

叶寒的要求无疑是将戴沐白往死里逼。

“不，不可能！”

戴沐白当然明白主动提出解除婚约的后果是什么，毫不犹豫地将拒绝。

“戴沐白，我刚才怎么说的。”

“我的命令就是圣旨，你敢违背？”

叶寒听到答复，双眼微微一眯，身上释放出一股冰冷的杀意。

“老大，我不能解除婚约，也没有这个能力。”

“就算是我写信回去，帝国也不会同意的。”

“反而还会遭受帝国的严重惩罚。”

戴沐白连连摇头，眼神中闪过一丝绝望。

他逃离星罗帝国，就是想在皇位争夺之前，多活几年。

“戴沐白，你没得选择。”

“这是命令！”

叶寒才不管戴沐白的后果是什么，会经历什么，他只需要一个结果。

戴沐白望着叶寒那要杀人的眸光，抿了抿嘴，坚决道：“不可能！”

“呵呵，好，你很有骨气！”

叶寒见戴沐白又拒绝了，抬手扇了一巴掌过去。

响亮的巴掌声响起，震得大家浑身一颤。

我的天！

叶寒也太霸道了。

动不动就扇人耳光。

就连星罗帝国的三皇子也敢扇，胆子不是一般的大。

要知道，把戴沐白揍了，那还说得过去，毕竟是实力不如人。

星罗帝国也不会说什么，就当做是正常的历练。

但扇耳光就过分了，戴沐白是星罗帝国皇子，扇他的耳光就是在扇星罗帝国的耳光。

“叶寒，你太过分了！”

“我跟你拼了！”

打人不打脸，骂人不揭短。

揍他可以，就是不能扇他耳光。

在无尽愤怒之下，戴沐白唤出邪眸白虎武魂，发了狂似地跟叶寒拼命。

“不自量力！”

Ye Hanhan looked at Dai Mubai, his tone full of majesty and indifference.

It seemed that as long as Dai Mubai dared to refuse, he would take action without hesitation.

Zhu Zhuqing was deeply moved when she saw that Ye Han wanted to make the decision for her and help her break off the engagement.

As the daughter of the Zhu family of the Star Luo Empire, the most important way to get rid of her fate is to continuously improve her strength and become the heir of the family, or to become a titled Douluo to completely get rid of the constraints of the empire and family and gain freedom.

In addition to this method, there is also a very demanding method, which is to terminate the engagement.

However, not everyone can terminate their engagement. Some very strict conditions need to be met, and the prince of the Dai family must take the initiative and obtain the consent of the empire.

The prince who proposes to terminate the engagement must be sterile, seriously ill, or seriously injured.

As long as the prince is healthy, he must abide by family rules and compete for supremacy.

Otherwise, the prince who proposes to terminate the engagement will be severely punished by the empire.

Now, in order to help her get rid of the family's competition rules, Ye Han actually asked Dai Mubai to take the initiative to terminate the engagement and let him bear the responsibility alone to minimize her risk. How could she not be moved.

【bite!Zhu Zhuqing's loyalty is 40%, and the reward is 5,000 exchange points.】

Ye Han received a notification from the system and knew that the method of terminating the engagement had worked.

In any case, he must help Zhu Zhuqing cancel the engagement today.

"Engagement?"

"Dean Fu, they can't be from Xingluo Dai family and Zhu family."

"No wonder their martial spirits look so familiar to me."

When Ning Fengzhi heard the word "marriage contract", he instantly guessed the identities of Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing, and asked Flanders for the answer.

"Yes."

Flanders nodded, his face full of helplessness.

Almost all soul masters in Douluo Continent know the rules of the Star Luo royal family.

It is really difficult to break off an engagement.

Ye Han's request undoubtedly drove Dai Mubai to death.

"No, it's impossible!"

Of course Dai Mubai understood the consequences of initiating the proposal to terminate the engagement and refused without hesitation.

"Dai Mubai, what did I just say?"

"My orders are imperial edicts, do you dare to disobey them?"

When Ye Han heard the reply, his eyes narrowed slightly, and a cold killing intent was released from his body.

"Boss, I can't cancel the engagement, and I don't have the ability."

"Even if I write a letter back, the empire won't agree."

"On the contrary, you will suffer severe punishment from the empire."

Dai Mubai shook his head repeatedly, a trace of despair flashed in his eyes.

He fled the Star Luo Empire just to live a few more years before the fight for the throne.

"Dai Mubai, you have no choice."

"This is an order!"

Ye Han didn't care what consequences Dai Mubai would suffer or what he would go through, he only wanted one result.

Dai Mubai looked at Ye Han's murderous eyes, pursed his lips, and said resolutely: "Impossible!"

"Haha, okay, you have a lot of backbone!"

When Ye Han saw Dai Mubai refused again, he raised his hand and slapped him.

A loud slap sounded, making everyone tremble.

Oh My God!

Ye Han was too domineering.

He slaps people in the face at every turn.

Even the third prince of the Star Luo Empire dared to slap him, he was very courageous.

You know, beating up Dai Mubai is still justified, after all, he is not as strong as others.

The Star Luo Empire wouldn't say anything and just regarded it as a normal experience.

But a slap in the face is too much. Dai Mubai is the prince of the Star Luo Empire, so slapping him is a slap in the face of the Star Luo Empire.

"Ye Han, you have gone too far!"

"I'll fight you!"

Don't slap people in the face when you hit them, don't expose their shortcomings when scolding people.

You can beat him, but you can't slap him.

In his endless anger, Dai Mubai summoned the evil-eyed white tiger spirit and frantically fought against Ye Han.

"Don't overestimate your capabilities!"
